{{Quote|Exquisite''"<br />"''Quite. A gift from Senator Eelen Li.''"<br />"''From Triffis.''"<br />"''A museum piece, actually.|Chancellor Finis Valorum and Senator Palpatine|<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
After residing for a time in a [[Unidentified Triffian museum|museum]] on [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Triffis/Legends|Triffis]], an ancient '''carving''' of a member of the [[Triffian/Legends|Triffian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was presented to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] as a gift by the Triffian Senator [[Eelen Li]]. Palpatine displayed the piece in his [[Palpatine's apartment/Legends|apartment suite]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
